description: English spell check with suggestions. Check spelling. Fast English spell checker (US and UK): flags misspellings with ranked suggestions, offsets and an auto-corrected text. Drop-in replacement for the retired Bing Spell Check API (format=bing).

format.description: Leave empty for the full response, or bing for the Bing Spell Check v7 response shape

ignore_uppercase.description: Skip ALL-CAPS words like acronyms (true/false, default true) (e.g. true)

language.description: en-US (default), en-GB or en (any English). Also accepts mkt=en-US like Bing (e.g. en-US)

mode.description: proof (default: spelling + repeated words) or spell (spelling only) (e.g. proof)

text.description: Text to check (max 20,000 characters) (e.g. I recieve alot of emails abuot the the project.)

words.description: Comma-separated custom words to accept (brand names, jargon) (e.g. TidyData,Kubernetes)

name: spell_check
title: English spell check with suggestions
